comments.author: OldManJohnson
comments.body_html:
When a bug occurs regardless of the SPT setup (fresh, old, mods, no mods, etc.), all I can think of that could cause the problem would be their PC and what they have installed.

CPU, RAM, GPU, associated drivers, apps, etc.

It’s proof of why quality control testing of a new OS or video game or whatever can only catch so much, until it’s released and all the trillions of possible combinations of whatever in someone’s machine can find the remainder of “incompatible configurations”.

Or it could be a “bug” that no one can fix because no one can figure why it happens…….because it’s most likely part of the fundamental core structure of the product. Like the need to reset a router/modem every now and then. They slow down, get spotty internet, lose connection with the ISP, etc. and the only real fix is to “turn it off, wait 30 seconds, then turn it back on”.

Don’t kill yourself over this, please.

comments.author: Fershte
comments.body_html:
If you go to the files,

GearGal/db/assort.json, you’ll find “editpointMMAC” in 3 places in the mod.

I use this as my boilerplate to add a new item. Simply duplicate those fields so it looks like this:

{

“_id”: “editpointMMAC”,

“_tpl”: “61bc85697113f767765c7fe7”,

“parentId”: “hideout”,

“slotId”: “hideout”,

“upd”: {

“UnlimitedCount”: true,

“StackObjectsCount”: 999999999

}

},

{

“_id”: “editpointMMAC”,

“_tpl”: “61bc85697113f767765c7fe7”,

“parentId”: “hideout”,

“slotId”: “hideout”,

“upd”: {

“UnlimitedCount”: true,

“StackObjectsCount”: 999999999

}

}, and later (in the “barter_scheme” you’ll have

“editpointMMAC”: [

[

{

“count”: 37200,

“_tpl”: “5449016a4bdc2d6f028b456f”

}

]

],

“editpointMMAC”: [

[

{

“count”: 37200,

“_tpl”: “5449016a4bdc2d6f028b456f”

}

]

],

and lastly in the “Loyalty_Level_Items”

“editpointMMAC”: 1,

“editpointMMAC”: 1,

Now what you want to do is change the 2nd “editpointMMAC” to whatever item you want to add, in your case, the Osprey rig.

Change the _tpl in that first section to the itemId of the Osprey rig found using https://db.sp-tarkov.com/search

in the barter_trade section change the quantity from 37200 to whatever you want the item to cost, and boom, new item.

comments.body_html:
Thanks to Shermuel

Temp fix.

Go into your SPT folder, user -> mods -> GearGal -> src.

Open up the “mod” file with notepad.

CTRL + F traderConfig.durabilityPurchaseThreshhold[baseJson._id] = 5;

Add // in front of traderConfig.durabilityPurchaseThreshhold[baseJson._id] = 5;

// traderConfig.durabilityPurchaseThreshhold[baseJson._id] = 5;

Line 68, in the javascript file “mod” will now look like this ^

Save the file. I did this with his other two mods and it worked like a charm. Traders appear, guns and items appear, and I can buy things with no issue.
